annotations.text:
What this stayed inside

No balances — the book is a people screen, money lives on the wallet crown.

No counts on the filter chips (§448), no colour for more or less, no inferred relationships (§295: factual only).

Nothing animates an ARRIVAL (§79) — every moment here answers something you just did.

Every moment lands immediately under Reduce Motion; the boards demonstrate that (view them with Reduce Motion on).

None of the five needs a new Thing field, a request, or a CloudKit deploy.

Already shipped — deliberately not re-proposed

Rows settle in staggered on open. The save whispers its rewrite count, scrolls, lifts the row and flies a face into it (§462). The card's face settles under a ring sweep and its address fills from the ends (§444). A filed face is absorbed by the group deck (§441). Copy swaps to a checkmark with a haptic.

And the sheet zoom transition is NOT on the table: §232 dropped .navigationTransition(.zoom) for sheets after a device-specific crash. Moment 1 rides the book's own flight overlay instead.

Cheapest first, if you only want some

4 · The scrub lands — one property on the section header.

5 · Copy sweeps — one phase on chunks that already exist.

3 · Narrows, not replaces — a transition on the row, no new state.

1 · Opens into its own face — reuses AddressFlightOverlay with a new key pair; the reveal becomes the landing.

2 · Deals a deck — the largest: the field's preview slot has to hold five faces, and the deal is the save flight run N times.
